title: Resort Club Member Deposit Relief on Room Reservations
content:
**Notice to Resort Club members.** When the deposit your Room Reservations reservation at your club's resort requires is worked out again after a change raises its nightly rate: if you hold an active Family Resort Club or Founders Resort Club membership at the same resort, the family club deposit relief of 25% is taken off the deposit; an active membership of any other level at that resort takes off the club deposit relief of 10%; a guest with no active club membership at that resort has no club relief taken off (0%).

The relief is read from the Resort Club Memberships record at the resort the reservation is for — its level and its status, only active counting. It takes that share off the deposit the reservation requires as it stands at that point, before the money held is taken off.

**Questions answered.**

*Which levels receive 25%?* The Family Resort Club Membership and the Founders Resort Club Membership, when active at the same resort.

*Which receive 10%?* The Fitness Club, Pool & Fitness Club, Spa Club and Beach & Pool Club Memberships, when active at the same resort.

*My membership is under notice of cancellation.* Only an active membership counts; under notice, no club relief is taken off.

*What does 25% come to?* On a hypothetical deposit requirement of 400.00, the family club relief takes off 100.00, leaving 300.00; the 10% club relief would leave 360.00.
